items.title: File Klage against the use prohibition (Nutzungsuntersagung) with the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden; ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt.
items.computation: The letter is internally inconsistent about its own date: the letterhead prints 'Datum 20.11.2026', but the body says 'mit diesem Bescheid vom 18.11.2026'. Per the rule to use the earliest plausible reading when a letter contradicts itself, I take the posting day as 18.11.2026 (Wednesday). Under §41 Abs.2 VwVfG NRW, an administrative letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 18.11.2026 + 4 days = 22.11.2026 (Sunday); for this type of notice the deemed-delivery day itself is not shifted for falling on a weekend. Counting of the 1-month Klage period then starts the next day under §187 Abs.1 BGB: 23.11.2026. One month later ends on the same numbered day of the following month under §188 Abs.2 BGB: 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). That day is a normal business day in NRW (no holiday), so it is not shifted further (§31 Abs.3 VwVfG / §57 Abs.2 VwGO with §222 Abs.2 ZPO). If instead the later printed date (20.11.2026) is the correct posting day, the same method gives 24.12.2026 — the safer, earlier date of 22.12.2026 is used here.

warnings: The letter contradicts itself about its own date: the letterhead says 'Datum 20.11.2026' but the body refers to 'diesem Bescheid vom 18.11.2026'; the due date was computed from the earlier date (18.11.2026) as the more conservative, earliest-plausible reading, and confidence was lowered to medium — if the Bescheid was actually posted on 20.11.2026, the Klage deadline would instead be 24.12.2026.

This is a deadline for a court action (Klage) against a Nutzungsuntersagung with real consequences (the basement room may not be let as living space); get advice from a lawyer or a Mieterverein/Verbraucherzentrale well before the deadline, especially if the person disputes the finding about windows and the second escape route.

The letter states explicitly that no Widerspruch procedure applies ('ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt') — only a direct Klage to the Verwaltungsgericht is possible, so an informal objection to the city will not preserve the deadline.
